name: mc_plan
title: Plan and preview a build
description: Validates and simulates a direct build or saved blueprint without placing temporary blocks. Returns world-space bounds, requested volume, final material counts, changes to existing non-air cells, clearing, overlaps, door/bed pairing errors and advisory support warnings. Optionally renders the final virtual scene as a flat map-color or shape-aware angled schematic PNG. WHEN TO USE: optional escalation when the user requests a planned preview/strict site analysis or a concrete placement risk needs investigation; not a routine prerequisite for every nontrivial build; to find misplaced components, terrain/structure collisions, missing halves or supports; to inspect a transformed blueprint or material variant. WHEN NOT TO USE: to place blocks (mc_build), inspect only existing terrain (mc_survey/mc_render), or verify actual placed blocks (mc_verify is opt-in). PARAMETERS: build contains the same fields as mc_build, including blueprint, transform, fills, blocks, text, world and execution options. image defaults true; preview accepts top/north/south/east/west/slice/isometric/perspective, optional camera azimuth/elevation/perspective fov, scale 0-16, grid 0-64 and slice:{axis,at}. Use image:false for analysis without a bounded image read. Material colors are lossy; use report counts and legends. Invalid request/state/limit errors reject before analysis; pairing errors appear in a successful report with valid:false. Protected-region overlaps (mc_protect) appear as `protected` rows with `protectedPass`; build.override marks rows as overridden. Support failures and overwritten non-air cells are advisory, since terrain cannot be reliably distinguished from structures. SIDE EFFECTS: no block writes, snapshots, blueprint writes or console commands. Reads may load chunks. Not a reservation or prediction of fluid spreading, connections, entities or later concurrent edits. Diagnostic truncation is explicitly reported.

build.description: Same request fields as mc_build; populated from its authoritative schema at registration.

camera.description: Angled views only. Compass azimuth (north=0, east=90), default 135. Elevation defaults 35.26438968 for isometric and 30 for perspective. Perspective fov defaults 50, invalid on isometric. Work budgets can reduce resolution, reported explicitly.
